description: MARS golden benchmark — versioned query set with ONLY deterministic, offline-checkable expectations. No model-specific prose. Each query is run through the production graph with the deterministic golden mock (bench/mock_pipeline.py GoldenFakeLLM/GoldenFakeSearch); expectations are checked against the resulting report and measured pipeline state.

field_contract.id: stable query id; never reused across versions
required_dimensions: loose-match research axes: at least min_dimensions_hit must appear in the plan/evidence
field_contract.min_dimensions_hit: how many of required_dimensions must be present
forbidden_domains: off-topic senses/domains that MUST NOT appear in cited sources
required_sections: human section names; each must be present (alias-tolerant, reusing synthesizer REQUIRED_SECTIONS)

minimums.corroborated_claims: >= this many claims with independent corroboration (grade evidence)
minimums.distinct_domains: >= this many distinct source registrable domains
minimums.sections: >= this many of required_sections present (loose), 0 = all

field_contract.fixture: deterministic offline pages + scripted answer used by the golden mock; see bench/golden/fixtures_v1.py
